economy.summary: His campaign site says he is creating opportunities for everyone in the local economy, from supporting small and diverse businesses to developing apprenticeship programs.
economy.short: Supports small and diverse businesses; develops apprenticeship programs.

taxes.summary: After the 135-day 2025 state budget impasse, said the General Assembly did not fulfill its constitutional obligation to pass the budget on time and proposed withholding lawmakers' pay until a budget passes; called the budget's one-year transit funding a Band-Aid.
taxes.short: Proposes withholding lawmaker pay until state budgets pass on time.

abortion.summary: Voted against 2022 proposed constitutional amendments stating the Pennsylvania Constitution confers no right to abortion, and against earlier bills restricting specific abortion procedures and reasons; has stated that abortion is healthcare.
abortion.short: Voted against abortion restrictions; says abortion is healthcare.

education.summary: His campaign site says he brought home $500 million in direct funding for Philadelphia and Delaware County public schools and is making sure every student has access to the best possible education.
education.short: Says he secured $500 million for district public schools.

healthcare.summary: Introduced a six-bill package in 2022 with other Delaware County legislators to restrict for-profit and private-equity hospital deals, including a moratorium on for-profit hospital purchases, state oversight of health system ownership changes, and limits on real estate splits, responding to cuts at Crozer Health.
healthcare.short: Introduced bills restricting for-profit and private-equity hospital deals.

energy.summary: Joined fellow Democratic legislators and environmental groups in 2021 to call for using part of Pennsylvania's $7 billion in American Rescue Plan funds for clean water and environmental infrastructure projects, criticizing the decision to hold the funds in reserve.
energy.short: Called for spending federal relief funds on clean-water infrastructure.

guns.summary: His campaign site says he created the Philadelphia Illegal Gun Task Force, has secured more than $50 million for gun violence prevention, and continues to lead the fight against crime and violence.
guns.short: Cites creating Illegal Gun Task Force; funds violence prevention.
